Advisor 08:46: the reviewer refused #2778 at 92a697a7c6. Full text: ~/ai/aida-worktrees/aida-pr-2778/.aida/review-verdicts/. Fix on a NEW head, round 2 of 2:
1 BLOCKER: CI (cli-0) Run tests fails at your head (run 39449477883) while main is green. It passes under nextest shadow, so look for a libtest shared-process interaction (env, cwd, a static lock, or the store-write.lock now held longer). Reproduce with the failing test name and fix it.
2 RAISED TO BLOCKING by advisor ruling: do NOT run git gc (gc --auto in the foreground or --aggressive) while holding store-write.lock. The live store has about 110k loose objects, so the first gc would hold the lock for minutes and every concurrent writer would hit the 120 s timeout. git's own locks make gc safe to run outside AIDA's writer lock: run it after the lock is released (or detached, with gc.autoDetach left at its default), and keep the lock only around AIDA's own read-modify-write.
3 gc_auto: honour global/system gc.auto (git config --get gc.auto, not --local only), and AIDA_STORE_GC_AUTO=off must disable it.
4 Barrier tests for heal_doctor_parent_tag_drift, heal_doctor_orphan_queue_entry and store_compact (at least these three); list the rest as remaining in the PR body.
Merge origin/main, gate, push, then mail the advisor.
subject: PR-2778 round 1: CI red + gc-under-lock (TASK-1981)
